about.description: Version information and settings data management.

debugMode.description: Enable debug mode to show additional buttons in the task header for viewing API conversation history and UI messages as prettified JSON in temporary files.

tools.description: Manage reusable skills, agents, and MCP servers.
tools.managementDescription: Preferences apply when you save settings. Creating, editing, or deleting resources takes effect immediately.
tools.advancedDescription: Enable executable custom tools only when you trust their source.

skills.description: Skills encapsulate contextual instructions and workflows, which the agent can load on-demand. They can include general instructions, specific workflows and even scripts to be run as needed. <DocsLink>Learn more</DocsLink>
skills.catalogError: Skills could not be refreshed. Previously loaded skills are kept; retry to refresh the list.
skills.appliesImmediately: Creating, editing, deleting, and changing mode availability updates skill files immediately.
skills.noWorkspaceSkills: No skills in this project yet.

modeDialog.description: Choose which modes can use this skill
modeDialog.intro: To keep your context light, we recommend only making skills available for the modes that need them.

skills.builtinDescription: Included with Alpha. Changes apply when you save settings. Workspace and personal skills with the same name take precedence; disabling a built-in does not disable your overrides.

collapseThinking.label: Collapse thinking
collapseThinking.description: When enabled, thinking blocks will be collapsed by default until you interact with them

requireCtrlEnterToSend.label: Enter inserts a newline
requireCtrlEnterToSend.description: Use {{primaryMod}}+Enter or Shift+Enter to send new messages. Enter still saves an edited message.

autoSteer.label: Auto-steer messages
autoSteer.description: When enabled, messages you submit while Alpha is working steer the current turn automatically. When disabled (default), messages wait in the queue until the current turn finishes. You can still select Steer on a queued message to deliver it sooner.

maxConcurrentTasks.label: Maximum parallel tasks
maxConcurrentTasks.description: The number of live tasks that can run at the same time. Failed and completed tasks do not count against this limit.

codeIndex.embeddingApiKeyPlaceholder: Enter the selected provider's API key
codeIndex.embeddingApiKeySaved: An API key is already saved for this provider.
codeIndex.bedrockAuthenticationDescription: Use your AWS credential chain or a named profile. An optional Bedrock API key can be used when no profile is selected.
codeIndex.compatibleAuthenticationDescription: The API key is optional for endpoints that do not require authentication.
codeIndex.freshnessNote: Embeddings are catching up. Validated indexed results and recent saved edits remain searchable; semantic results for the newest code may be incomplete.
codeIndex.title: Codebase Indexing
codeIndex.description: Configure codebase indexing settings to enable semantic search of your project. <0>Learn more</0>
codeIndex.enableDescription: Enable code indexing for improved search and context understanding
codeIndex.disabledMessage: Codebase indexing is currently disabled. Enable it in the global settings to configure indexing options.
codeIndex.geminiApiKeyPlaceholder: Enter the API key for your indexing project
codeIndex.geminiApiKeySaved: API key saved securely. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new key to replace it.
codeIndex.searchMinScoreDescription: Minimum similarity score (0–1) for semantic matches. Higher values filter more semantic matches and may exclude useful code. Keyword matches can still be returned. This score is not a confidence percentage.
codeIndex.searchMaxResultsDescription: Return up to this many code chunks, within the search context budget. Duplicate, stale or inaccessible chunks are excluded, so fewer chunks may be returned. This limit does not change how broadly the index is searched.
codeIndex.embeddingRateLimitDescription: Spaces embedding inputs across indexing, file updates and searches. Gemini batches account for every input. Provider cooldowns pause queued requests after a rate-limit response. Increase the interval to match your project's quota.
codeIndex.unsavedSettingsMessage: Please save your settings before starting the indexing process.

clearDataDialog.title: Are you sure?
clearDataDialog.description: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your codebase index data.

codeIndex.localIndexPathDescription: Stored inside this workspace when a relative path is used.

autoApprove.advancedDescription: Manage command rules, protected files, MCP grants, and confirmation limits.

mode.label: Default permission mode
mode.description: Choose the default for new chats. Change permissions for an individual chat from its composer.
mode.askDescription: Auto-approve workspace reads. Ask before writes, commands, managed-agent launches, Alpha Tickets, and outside paths. Saved command prefixes can allow matching commands; MCP tools ask unless enabled below for an individually granted tool.
mode.autoDescription: Auto-approve workspace reads, in-workspace file changes and commands, Alpha Tickets for the current project, and eligible bounded managed-agent launches. Agent delegation follows your requests and applicable project or skill instructions. Approval settings do not enable delegation by themselves; child authority stays within the parent's policy. Ask for outside changes, protected changes unless enabled below, and MCP without an enabled saved tool grant. Command deny rules still apply.
mode.bypassDescription: Also auto-approve outside paths, protected files, and valid MCP tool calls. Follow-up questions use the answer setting below. Command deny rules still apply. Managed-agent delegation policy and inherited child authority still apply.

bypassWarning.title: Enable Full Access?
bypassWarning.body: Full Access auto-approves writes and commands outside the opened workspace, protected files, and MCP. Follow-up questions use your saved answer setting. The deny-list still blocks forbidden commands.

autoApprove.description: Run these actions without asking for permission. Only enable for actions you fully trust and if you understand the security risks.
autoApprove.toggleShortcut: You can configure a keyboard shortcut for this setting <SettingsLink>in your IDE preferences</SettingsLink>.

readOnly.label: Read
readOnly.description: When enabled, Alpha will automatically view directory contents and read files without requiring you to click the Approve button.

outsideWorkspace.label: Include files outside workspace
outsideWorkspace.description: Allow Alpha to read files outside the current workspace without requiring approval.

write.label: Write
write.description: Automatically create and edit files without requiring approval
write.delayLabel: Delay after writes to allow diagnostics to detect potential problems

outsideWorkspace.label: Include files outside workspace
outsideWorkspace.description: Allow Alpha to create and edit files outside the current workspace without requiring approval.

protected.label: Include protected files
protected.description: Allow Alpha to create and edit protected files (like .alphaignore and .alpha/ configuration files) without requiring approval.

mcp.label: Enable saved MCP tool grants
mcp.description: In Ask or Auto, auto-approval requires both this setting and the exact tool's individual "Always allow" grant in the MCP Servers view. Tool annotations do not grant approval.
mcp.bypassDescription: Full Access auto-approves valid MCP tool calls regardless of saved tool grants. Choose Ask or Auto to use individual grants and approval prompts.

modeSwitch.label: Mode
modeSwitch.description: Automatically switch between different modes without requiring approval

subtasks.label: Subtasks
subtasks.description: Allow creation and completion of subtasks without requiring approval

subagents.label: Sub-agents
subagents.description: Allow Alpha to launch read-only sub-agent groups without requiring approval. Read access must also be auto-approved.

tickets.label: Alpha Tickets
tickets.description: Automatically approve creating, updating, and deleting Alpha Tickets for the current project.

followupQuestions.label: Question
followupQuestions.description: Automatically select the first suggested answer for follow-up questions after the configured timeout
followupQuestions.waitDescription: Require an answer before the agent continues, including in Full Access. Turn this off to allow Full Access to ask optional questions while continuing, or select suggested answers after the delay below. Ask and Auto always wait for your answers.

execute.inheritedRules: Command rules from VS Code settings
execute.inheritedRulesDescription: These rules also apply to this workspace. Edit them in the VS Code settings where they were defined.
execute.label: Command rules
execute.description: Auto approves commands run from the workspace. Detected outside or unresolved write paths ask for review; deny rules still block commands. Path checks are not an OS sandbox. Saved rules persist across projects.
execute.allowedCommandsDescription: Add an executable and complete argument prefix to allow matching commands in Ask. Arguments match case-sensitively, and any matching deny rule takes precedence. Auto and Full Access already allow wildcard command execution, so this list does not narrow those modes. In Ask and Auto, protected changes and outside or unresolved write paths may still require approval. Saved rules apply globally.
execute.deniedCommandsDescription: Executable and complete argument prefixes denied in every approval mode without asking for approval. Arguments match case-sensitively. Any matching deny rule takes precedence over allowed commands. Add * to deny all commands.
execute.autoDenied: Commands with the prefix `{{prefix}}` have been forbidden by the user. Do not bypass this restriction by running another command.
execute.pathApprovalDescription: Paths outside this task or unknown write locations. Approval is for this run only.
execute.pathApprovalUnresolved: Some write paths could not be resolved.

maxLimits.label: Confirmation limits
maxLimits.description: Each task uses these confirmation checkpoints. Blank values (or 0 cost) mean unlimited. Alpha asks before another model request after the request count or reported API cost exceeds its allowance; confirming resets both. Cost is checked after usage is reported and may exceed the amount before confirmation.

autoApprove.selectOptionsFirst: Select at least one option below to enable auto-approval

chatGpt.disconnected: Sign in to use your ChatGPT account.
chatGpt.description: Your ChatGPT account is shared across profiles. Model and reasoning choices remain separate.

bedrock.credentialsDescription: Leave both keys blank to use your configured AWS credential chain. Enter both keys to use explicit credentials; add a session token for temporary credentials.
bedrock.inferenceProfileDescription: Use an inference profile for the selected supported model. Leave blank to use its listed route. The selected model still defines the reasoning choices. Shown prices use Global Standard rates; regional and custom-profile pricing may differ.

providers.outputTokenLimitDescription: When included, leave blank for the model default or enter -1 for the provider default.
providers.description: Save different API configurations to quickly switch between providers and settings.

saveErrors.notFound: This saved profile no longer exists. Your edits have been kept. Select or create a profile before saving.
saveErrors.saveFailed: Unable to complete saving this profile. Your edits have been kept. Please try again.
saveErrors.timeout: Saving took longer than expected. Your edits have been kept. Please try again.

renameErrors.notFound: This saved profile could not be found. Refresh the profiles and try again.

providers.vscodeLmDescription: The VS Code Language Model API lets Alpha use models made available by providers such as GitHub Copilot in this VS Code window.
providers.apiKeyStorageNotice: API keys are stored securely in VSCode's Secret Storage
providers.noCustomHeaders: No custom headers defined. Click the + button to add one.

refreshModels.label: Refresh Models
refreshModels.hint: Please reopen the settings to see the latest models.
refreshModels.error: Failed to refresh models list. Please try again.
refreshModels.missingConfig: Enter the required provider configuration before refreshing models.

providers.vertexStreamingEnabledDescription: Disable this when the selected model does not support streaming. Responses will appear after completion.
providers.vertex1MContextBetaDescription: Extends context window to 1 million tokens for Claude Sonnet 4.x / Claude Opus 4.6
providers.vscodeLmUnavailable: This saved model is no longer in Alpha's supported model list. Choose a supported model to replace it.

vscodeLmContextSize.label: Context window
vscodeLmContextSize.description: Choose the input-token budget sent to GitHub Copilot for this model. Extended context can consume more premium requests.

providers.vscodeLmWarning: Alpha lists its supported models. Model access is checked when a task starts. If your Copilot account cannot use the selected model, the task reports an error. VS Code may ask you to approve access the first time.
providers.vertexCredentialsHelp: Leave credentials JSON and key file blank to use Application Default Credentials.

googleCloudSetup.title: Google Cloud setup
googleCloudSetup.step1: Enable Vertex AI and model access

providers.vertexConnectionRemoved: This saved profile uses a custom Vertex connection that is no longer supported. Switch to standard Google Cloud credentials, then save the profile.

customModel.capabilities: Configure the capabilities and pricing for your custom OpenAI-compatible model. Be careful when specifying the model capabilities, as they can affect how Alpha performs.

maxTokens.label: Max Output Tokens
maxTokens.description: Per-response output cap, including reasoning tokens where the provider counts them. Enter a positive whole number, or -1 to use the server default. This is separate from context size and cumulative task budgets.

contextWindow.label: Context Window Size
contextWindow.description: Total tokens (input + output) the model can process.

imageSupport.label: Image Support
imageSupport.description: Is this model capable of processing and understanding images?

temperatureSupport.label: Supports temperature
temperatureSupport.description: Declares support for temperature on Chat Completions routes. Disable this if the model does not support temperature. The temperature control appears for supported request routes.

computerUse.label: Computer Use
computerUse.description: Is this model capable of interacting with a browser?

promptCache.label: Prompt Caching
promptCache.description: Is this model capable of caching prompts?

input.label: Input Price
input.description: Cost per million tokens in the input/prompt. This affects the cost of sending context and instructions to the model.

output.label: Output Price
output.description: Cost per million tokens in the model's response. This affects the cost of generated content and completions.

cacheReads.label: Cache Reads Price
cacheReads.description: Cost per million tokens for reading from the cache. This is the price charged when a cached response is retrieved.

cacheWrites.label: Cache Writes Price
cacheWrites.description: Cost per million tokens for writing to the cache. This is the price charged when a prompt is cached for the first time.

rateLimitSeconds.label: Rate limit
rateLimitSeconds.description: Minimum time between API requests using this provider profile, shared across parent and sub-agents.

consecutiveMistakeLimit.label: Error & Repetition Limit
consecutiveMistakeLimit.description: Number of consecutive errors before showing the 'Alpha is having trouble' dialog. Repeated tool results may prompt one strategy change, but do not pause the task. Set to 0 to disable both limits.
consecutiveMistakeLimit.unlimitedDescription: Unlimited retries enabled (auto-proceed). The dialog will never appear.
consecutiveMistakeLimit.warning: ⚠️ Setting to 0 allows unlimited retries which may consume significant API usage

verbosity.label: Output Verbosity
verbosity.description: Controls response detail on supported request routes. Server default omits the verbosity parameter. Low produces concise answers; high provides thorough explanations.

timeout.label: Checkpoint timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum wait for checkpoint initialization or saving. A timeout disables checkpoints for that task. Default: 15 seconds (10–60). Changes apply to new or resumed tasks.

enable.label: Automatic checkpoints
enable.description: Save recovery snapshots during tasks. Turn off to skip new checkpoints; existing snapshots remain saved. Changes apply to new or resumed tasks.

sound.label: Enable sound effects
sound.description: When enabled, Alpha will play sound effects for notifications and events.

contextManagement.customPromptNotice: Text summaries use the Codex CLI default shown here. A saved nonempty custom prompt, even a copy of this default, selects text summarization. Clear or reset it to allow native compaction on supported OpenAI API-key models. Other providers use text summaries.
contextManagement.description: Control what information is included in the AI's context window, affecting token usage and response quality

autoCondenseContextPercent.label: Compaction trigger
autoCondenseContextPercent.description: Compaction starts when usage reaches this share of the model's full context window. The trigger is capped to leave room for the next response and a safety buffer.

condensingScope.label: Count context usage
condensingScope.description: Count the full context or only tokens added since the initial or last compacted prefix. The model's full context limit always applies.

postTurnCondense.label: Compact after a response
postTurnCondense.description: After a response, compact when the full active context reaches this percentage of its usable limit. Zero disables this extra trigger; the automatic compaction trigger still applies.

condensingApiConfiguration.label: API Configuration for Context Condensing
condensingApiConfiguration.description: Select which API configuration to use for context condensing operations. Leave unselected to use the current active configuration.

customCondensingPrompt.label: Custom Context Condensing Prompt
customCondensingPrompt.description: Customize the final user message sent for text compaction. Task instructions remain in effect. Leave empty to use the Codex CLI default and allow native compaction where supported.
customCondensingPrompt.placeholder:
Enter your custom compaction prompt here...

Include current progress, constraints, remaining work, and critical references.

autoCondenseContext.name: Automatic context compaction
autoCondenseContext.description: When enabled, Alpha will automatically condense the context when the threshold is reached. When disabled, you can still manually trigger context condensing.

openTabs.label: Open tabs
openTabs.description: Maximum number of VSCode open tabs to include in context. Higher values provide more context but increase token usage.

workspaceFiles.label: Workspace files
workspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of files to include in current working directory details. Higher values provide more context but increase token usage.

alphaignore.label: Show .alphaignore'd files in lists and searches
alphaignore.description: When enabled, files matching patterns in .alphaignore will be shown in lists with a lock symbol. When disabled, these files will be completely hidden from file lists and searches.

maxConcurrentFileReads.label: Concurrent file reads limit
maxConcurrentFileReads.description: Maximum number of files the 'read_file' tool can process concurrently. Higher values may speed up reading multiple small files but increase memory usage.

maxReadFile.label: File read auto-truncate threshold
maxReadFile.description: Alpha reads this number of lines when the model omits start/end values. If this number is less than the file's total, Alpha generates a line number index of code definitions. Special cases: -1 instructs Alpha to read the entire file (without indexing), and 0 instructs it to read no lines and provides line indexes only for minimal context. Lower values minimize initial context usage, enabling precise subsequent line-range reads. Explicit start/end requests are not limited by this setting.

maxImageFileSize.label: Max image file size
maxImageFileSize.description: Maximum size (in MB) for image files that can be processed by the read file tool.

maxTotalImageSize.label: Max total image size
maxTotalImageSize.description: Maximum cumulative size limit (in MB) for all images processed in a single read_file operation. When reading multiple images, each image's size is added to the total. If including another image would exceed this limit, it will be skipped.

includeMessages.label: Include diagnostics automatically
includeMessages.description: When enabled, diagnostic messages (errors) from edited files will be automatically included in the context. You can always manually include all workspace diagnostics using @problems.

maxMessages.label: Maximum diagnostic messages
maxMessages.description: Limits the diagnostic messages included in context, prioritizing errors over warnings. Choose Unlimited to include all available messages.

delayAfterWrite.label: Diagnostic wait after writes
delayAfterWrite.description: Time to wait after file writes before proceeding, allowing diagnostic tools to process changes and detect issues.

includeCurrentTime.label: Include current time in context
includeCurrentTime.description: When enabled, the current time and timezone information will be included in the system prompt. Disable this if models are stopping work due to time concerns.

includeCurrentCost.label: Include current cost in context
includeCurrentCost.description: When enabled, the current API usage cost will be included in the system prompt. Disable this if models are stopping work due to cost concerns.

maxGitStatusFiles.label: Git status max files
maxGitStatusFiles.description: Maximum number of file entries to include in git status context. Set to 0 to disable. Branch info is always shown when > 0.

enableSubfolderRules.label: Discover subfolder rules
enableSubfolderRules.description: Recursively discover and load .alpha/rules and AGENTS.md files from subdirectories. Useful for monorepos with per-package rules.

advanced.description: Fine-tune context and recovery. Changes apply when you save settings.

diff.label: Enable editing through diffs
diff.description: When enabled, Alpha will be able to edit files more quickly and will automatically reject truncated full-file writes

descriptions.standard: Standard diff strategy applies changes to a single code block at a time.
descriptions.unified: Unified diff strategy takes multiple approaches to applying diffs and chooses the best approach.
descriptions.multiBlock: Multi-block diff strategy allows updating multiple code blocks in a file in one request.

todoList.label: Enable todo list tool
todoList.description: When enabled, Alpha can create and manage todo lists to track task progress. This helps organize complex tasks into manageable steps.

backgroundEditing.label: Background editing
backgroundEditing.description: Apply file edits in the background without opening diff views or moving editor focus. Files may still open without focus to collect diagnostics.

customTools.name: Enable custom tools
customTools.description: Load TypeScript or JavaScript tools from .alpha/tools in your project or ~/.alpha/tools. Tool modules can run code when loaded, so enable only tools you trust. Tool calls follow the current permissions.
customTools.saveToLoad: Save settings to load custom tools. Tool modules can run code when loaded.
customTools.noTools: No custom tools loaded. Add .ts or .js files to your project's .alpha/tools directory or ~/.alpha/tools for global tools.

promptCaching.label: Disable prompt caching
promptCaching.description: When checked, Alpha will not use prompt caching for this model.

temperature.description: Controls randomness in the model's responses.
temperature.rangeDescription: Higher values make output more random, lower values make it more deterministic.

modelInfo.enableR1FormatTips: Must be enabled when using R1 models such as QWQ to prevent 400 errors

modelPicker.automaticFetch: The extension automatically fetches the latest list of models available on <serviceLink>{{serviceName}}</serviceLink>. If you're unsure which model to choose, Alpha works best with <defaultModelLink>{{defaultModelId}}</defaultModelLink>. You can also try searching "free" for no-cost options currently available.
modelPicker.label: Model
modelPicker.simplifiedExplanation: You can adjust detailed model settings later.

validation.unsupportedProviderSettings: This saved provider uses unsupported settings: {{fields}}. Use provider defaults to clear these settings before saving.

validation.bedrockAuthMethod: Choose either an AWS profile or a Bedrock API key.

validation.modelOutputTokenLimit: Output token limit cannot exceed this model's maximum of {{maximum}} tokens.

validation.modelDeprecated: This model is no longer available. Please select a different model.

validation.modelNotAllowed: Model '{{model}}' is not allowed for provider '{{provider}}' by your organization
validation.profileInvalid: This profile contains a provider or model that is not allowed by your organization

includeMaxOutputTokensDescription: Send an explicit per-response output cap when a positive limit is configured. Unchecked, unset, or -1 uses the server default. Some endpoints may not support output caps.
limitMaxTokensDescription: Limit the maximum number of tokens in the response
maxTokensGenerateDescription: Maximum tokens to generate in response

serviceTier.label: Service tier
serviceTier.tooltip: For faster processing of API requests, try the priority processing service tier. For lower prices with higher latency, try the flex processing tier.
serviceTier.pricingTableTitle: Pricing by service tier (price per 1M tokens)

memory.title: Memories
memory.costNotice: Generating memories may incur provider charges. Saved memories are stored on the machine running Alpha.
memory.description: Alpha can learn preferences and useful context from eligible prior conversations on this extension host. Background updates use your selected provider and can incur model usage. Save changes to apply these settings.

enabled.label: Enable memories
enabled.description: Off by default. Turning this off stops memory use and generation while keeping existing files.

useMemories.label: Use memories
useMemories.description: Use saved memories starting with the next conversation. Existing conversations keep their captured context.

generateMemories.label: Generate memories
generateMemories.description: Allow this conversation and future conversations to contribute memories after they have been idle.

memory.resetDescription: Delete local memory files and conversation summaries for this Alpha home. Existing conversations and their captured context stay intact. This cannot be undone.
memory.invalid: Memory settings are invalid. Check the saved memory configuration.
